title: Why You Might Not Know Who Owns Your Stocks
hook: The biggest owners of corporate America aren't tycoons. They're index funds holding your money.
closing: Your index fund has a vote at the shareholder meeting. You don't.
question: Do you know who votes your shares?

segments.say: Index funds once held a sliver of the stock market. Now they hold 52 percent of it, and climbing.
BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street together now own 22 percent of a typical big company.
Vanguard alone casts nearly one in ten votes at big shareholder meetings -- one firm, that much say.
